screenGates.placeBooking>bookingPolicies: Deliberate (#3550, owner via Fable 2026-11-10): bookingPolicies keeps no place parent, because a later booking type (appointments, classes) reuses it. Today its only surfaces serve place bookings (the Reserve hub header and the availability screen), so placeBooking gates the screen and not the flag.
